bio: This is the fine dining restaurant of the long-established Hotel Schweizerhof. The small space is inviting, with an elegant and cosy feel, and the service team is friendly and attentive. The dishes are rooted in classic cuisine and draw on modern influences. The tasting menus Fauna and Flora (vegetarian) can be ordered in a four- to six-course format. The hotel garden has a sun terrace and there is also a bar....
